abstract: OBJECTIVE: To determine the outcome of pregnancies occurring before completion of human chorionic gonadotropin follow-up in patients treated with chemotherapy for gestational trophoblastic tumor. METHODS: Retrospective record review of patients with gestational trophoblastic tumor who conceived before standard hCG follow-up was completed during 1973-1998. RESULTS: Forty-three patients treated for gestational trophoblastic tumors conceived before human chorionic gonadotropin follow-up was completed. The antecedent pregnancy was complete mole in 31 (72.1%) and partial mole in 12 (27. 9%) patients. Of the 43 patients, 39 (90.7%) had stage I, 1 had stage II, and 3 had stage III disease. The mean interval from human chorionic gonadotropin remission to new pregnancy was 6.3 months (range 1-11 months). Ten patients underwent elective termination and four patients were lost to follow-up. Of the remaining 29 patients, 22 (75.9%) had term live births, 3 (10.3%) had preterm delivery, 3 had spontaneous abortion, and 1 (3.5%) had a repeat mole. Two cases of fetal anomalies were detected; one was inherited polydactyly and the other was hydronephrosis. One patient developed choriocarcinoma with lung involvement and underwent cesarean section at 28 weeks; a normal fetus was delivered and no choriocarcinoma was detected in the placenta. CONCLUSION: Pregnancies occurring in patients treated for gestational trophoblastic tumor before standard human chorionic gonadotropin follow-up is completed may continue under close clinical surveillance since the majority have a favorable outcome. However, patients should also be advised of the low but important risk of delayed diagnosis in case tumor relapse develops during early subsequent pregnancy.
abstract_ja: 目的：標準的なヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)フォローアップが完了する前に、絨毛性腫瘍に対して化学療法を受けた患者が妊娠した場合の転帰を明らかにすること。方法：1973年から1998年の間に、標準的なhCGフォローアップ完了前に妊娠した絨毛性腫瘍患者を対象に、後方視的な診療録レビューを行った。結果：hCGフォローアップ完了前に妊娠した絨毛性腫瘍患者は43例であった。先行妊娠は完全奇胎が31例（72.1%）、部分奇胎が12例（27.9%）であった。43例のうち39例（90.7%）が病期I、1例が病期II、3例が病期IIIであった。hCG寛解から新たな妊娠までの平均期間は6.3か月（範囲1～11か月）であった。10例は選択的人工妊娠中絶を受け、4例はフォローアップから脱落した。残りの29例のうち、22例（75.9%）が正期産で出生し、3例（10.3%）が早産、3例が自然流産、1例（3.5%）が再奇胎であった。胎児異常が2例で検出され、1例は遺伝性多指症、もう1例は水腎症であった。1例は肺病変を伴う絨毛癌を発症し、妊娠28週で帝王切開を受けた。正常な胎児が出生し、胎盤に絨毛癌は検出されなかった。結論：標準的なhCGフォローアップの完了前に妊娠した絨毛性腫瘍治療後の患者は、密な臨床的監視下で妊娠を継続してよい。大多数は良好な転帰をたどるからである。しかし、早期の妊娠中に腫瘍再発が生じた場合の診断遅延という低いが重要なリスクについても、患者に説明すべきである。
